dct_title_s: Map of the mineral regions of the counties of Gogebic and Ontonagon, Michigan, 1887 / published by Edw. P. Allis & H.B. Merrell compiled by Mess. J.M. Longyear and J.M. Case, Marquette, Mich.
dct_description_sm: Shows lands of Allis & Merrell in green, and of Case & Longyear in red. Also shows mines and mineral explorations, iron ranges, existing and projected railroads, wagon roads, and supply roads.; Relief shown by hachures.; "Supplement to the Mining, real estate & manufacturing reporter, Milwaukee, Wis., June 4th, 1887" --Upper margin.; "Copyright applied for by Edw. P. Allis, Milwaukee, Wis."
